name: mirage
text: Status on the stuck bets: I read the grading code and checked ESPN. It still serves scores for those dates and the 30-day cutoff isn't the cause. The stuck note means the score check found no result for those games, but I can't tell why without the bets themselves. Your phone hasn't saved its bet files to GitHub since Nov 4. Next step is to get one stuck bet's details (event, league, market, line) and test it against the real score. If you open Settings > Cloud scan and let the phone sync once, or send a bet-history export, I can pin it down.
